P01.rationale: No founder or person is used as a dominant human anchor; the page relies entirely on typographic elements and text blocks.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies with framed client portraits; only numbered points without associated imagery.

P07.rationale: A minimal social-proof element exists in the form of a press/logo wall at the bottom, though it is understated and not prominent.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present as large numerals (01–06) that serve as visual anchors for each point.

P11.rationale: No real data-visualisations bound to numbers are shown; the content is purely textual with no charts or before/after visuals.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with tightly packed text and structured points.

P13.rationale: The background is flat blankness without any intentional texture or atmosphere; it lacks visual depth or mood.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion does not apply — but since no image overlays exist, readability isn't tested here.

P16.rationale: No device/product mockup is shown; there are no visual representations of tools or platforms to add product credibility.

N07.rationale: The imagery (if any) appears generic/stock rather than specific to a real business — though mostly absent, the few elements feel templated.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly filled with content across most of the page area.

N10.rationale: No text sits on a busy photo without scrim or awkward inset gaps — since there are no photos, this issue does not arise.
